name: Shiphi
overview: Shiphi is a male member of the tribe of Simeon, identified as the son of Allon. His lineage places him within the Simeonite community as recorded in 1 Chronicles 4:37. There are no additional notes that expand on his character or role beyond his genealogical mention.
namesAndTitles: The name Shiphi means "flowing abundance," reflecting a Hebrew proper name with a positive connotation. This name is not indicated as given directly by God but is noted in Scripture in 1 Chronicles 4:37.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly identifies Shiphi as the son of Allon. It is also inferred that Ziza is his father, suggesting a generational link within the Simeonite family line. No further family relationships are recorded beyond these.
scriptureSignificance: Shiphi's significance lies primarily in his genealogical placement within the tribe of Simeon, contributing to the biblical record of Israelite family lines. His mention in 1 Chronicles 4:37 helps preserve the history and heritage of the Simeonites, which is important for understanding the tribal divisions and God's providential care for His people through their descendants.
